# Read Statistics charts
<!-- generated by docs:update_by_ai -->
<!-- page type: how-to -->

Open a chart in Statistics and point to a bar to read its values.

## Open a chart

<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/window/statistics_window.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/MoreMenu.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/StatisticsModal.vue -->

Open the **More** menu and choose **Statistics**. Select **User activity** or **Work of one person** in the window title bar to show that chart.

## Read a bar

<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/window/statistics_charts.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary/statistics_charts.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/UserActivityHistogram.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/StackedBarChart.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/ChartInformationCardPopover.vue -->

Read the chart legend above the bars to identify each color. Point to a bar to open its chart information card, which shows the bar's time or day, a total when its values can be added, and rows for the colors with values in that bar.

The chart information card closes when the pointer leaves the bar. The chart legend is explanatory in **User activity**; in **Work of one person**, selecting a legend name filters the chart, and selecting that name again shows every color.
